title: Fat Cats in the Hay
note: A stomp-along old-time number about three barn cats too well fed to move. Sung by a synthetic voice; the band is a fiddle, a harmony guitar and a strummed guitar.

arranging: A stomp-along old-time number for a room that claps. The fiddle drives the intro and the interlude as written and answers the singer with short runs between lines; on the last chorus it doubles the tune an octave up. The strummed guitar keeps the eighths moving under every verse; the band has no drums. Energy peaks on the last chorus; nothing drops to quiet. Keep the singer on top; little ducking.
